items.title: Snowman with an Oval Frame Outline
items.alt: Black-and-white snowman in a holly-decorated top hat leaning around a large blank oval frame.
items.description: The smiling face, fringed scarf and twig hands sit along the frame's left edge, leaving the center open.

items.title: Happy Winter Lettering with a Snowman
items.alt: Snow-capped Happy Winter lettering in red and teal, with a top-hatted snowman forming the letter I and blue snowflakes at the sides.
items.description: The two stacked words create a compact greeting, with a gold scarf adding a warm accent to the snowman.
